description: Ask Elfa for written market analysis grounded in its social data. Costs credits and varies by speed, so fast is the cheaper option. Pass sessionId from a previous reply to continue the same conversation. The reply includes sources: links to the posts and pages the research read (links only, not their text), so you can cite or check them.

analysisType.description: chat needs message. tokenIntro and tokenAnalysis need symbol, or chain plus contractAddress. accountAnalysis needs username. macro and summary need nothing else.

speed.description: Defaults to fast, which is cheaper and shallower. Ask for expert when the answer needs deeper reasoning.

name: market_chat

sources.description: Links the research read, in order, without duplicates. kind is x_post, x_account, telegram, dex, explorer, prediction_market or web; treat any other value as web. A source was read, not necessarily cited.

title: Market chat
